selection_reasoning: These four tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence centered around building/construction materials. The player first needs to find an oak_door (navigation/exploration task) which leads them to a structure. Near that structure, they can mine a birch_trapdoor (resource gathering). The iron_bars craft requires iron ingots which can be placed in the scene, and stone_stairs require stone blocks which can also be gathered. The dependency chain works as: finding the oak_door leads to the area where the birch_trapdoor can be mined, and both the iron_bars and stone_stairs crafts depend on resources found in/near the structure. The stone_stairs craft requires a crafting table which is accessed after mining the birch_trapdoor (which blocks access to it).

Mining the birch_trapdoor reveals a chest/area containing iron ingots needed for iron_bars
Mining the birch_trapdoor grants access to the crafting table and stone blocks needed for stone_stairs

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak door is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 2). max_distance reduced to 5 (from 16) so the player must actually walk toward the door rather than satisfying it at spawn. The door is ~7.3 blocks from spawn origin, so max_distance=5 requires the player to move at least 2-3 blocks closer. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the door.

Uses inventory_has because mining a birch_trapdoor drops the birch_trapdoor item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no birch_trapdoor in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms they mined it. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because the item directly enters inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting iron bars (6 iron ingots arranged in 2 rows of 3 on crafting table → 16 iron bars) places the iron bars into the player's inventory. The player starts with no iron bars, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting stone stairs (6 stone blocks arranged in stair pattern on crafting table → 4 stone_stairs) places the stone stairs into the player's inventory. The player starts with no stone stairs, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: A stone brick building with an oak door entrance facing south. Inside, the building is divided into two rooms by an interior stone brick wall at z=7. A birch trapdoor (closed, half=bottom) blocks the 1-block-wide passage in the dividing wall at (~7,1,7). The back room (z=8-11) contains a crafting table at (~9,1,10) and a chest at (~5,1,10) with 6 iron ingots and 12 stone blocks. Front room floor is stone, back room floor is oak planks.
task_text: Find the oak door on the stone brick building, enter through it, mine the birch trapdoor blocking the back room, then use the materials in the chest to craft iron bars and stone stairs at the crafting table.

Crafting table at (~9,1,10), chest at (~5,1,10) with 6 iron ingots and 12 stone. Torches at (~6,1,4) and (~9,1,9) provide lighting. Player spawns at origin facing the building ~7 blocks away.
